article.headline: Lee's 28 help Lamar knock off East Texas A&M 82-61
article.description: — Rob Lee Jr. socred 20 of his 28 points in the second half and Lamar beat East Texas A&M 82-61 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Lee's 28 help Lamar knock off East Texas A&M 82-61

categories.description: East Texas A&M Lions @ Lamar Cardinals

event.description: East Texas A&M Lions @ Lamar Cardinals

keywords: East Texas A&M Lions @ Lamar Cardinals
article.story: BEAUMONT, Texas -- — Rob Lee Jr. socred 20 of his 28 points in the second half and Lamar beat East Texas A&M 82-61 on Tuesday. Lee added seven rebounds for the Cardinals (11-10, 6-6 Southland Conference). Braden East scored 12 points while finishing 6 of 9 from the floor and added 11 rebounds and three blocks. King-Njhsanni Wilhite finished 5 of 9 from the field to finish with 12 points. The Lions (8-13, 3-8) were led in scoring by Damian Garcia, who finished with 11 points, four assists and four steals. Ronnie Harrison Jr. added 10 points and six rebounds for East Texas A&M. Noah Pagotto also had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
